text: {"lessons":["I should not rush to sell a stock just to enjoy a realized gain; I need to weigh its prospects and portfolio role before deciding.","I should not buy simply because a stock has risen or because I want to make up for a prior sale; every new purchase needs its own clear rationale.","I should judge my decisions by the whole portfolio and my forward-looking plan, not only by each stock’s gain or loss versus its purchase price."]}
